newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE WANTS WATER ON HARD ATHENS TRACK.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE WANTS WATER ON HARD ATHENS TRACK.

text.p: Ethiopia's Olympic 10,000 metres champion Haile Gebrselassie has asked organisers to water the track for the distance events at the world championships starting on Saturday in an effort to soften the surface.
Gebrselassie suffered with terrible blisters during his triumph on an equally hard track at the Atlanta Olympics and originally did not want to run at the Athens event because of the problem.
"We have spoken to officials about this and it seems it will be done," his Dutch manager Jos Hermens said on Friday.

"They have built a sprinters' track and the least they can do is water the track. But it is not that we have given them an ultimatum or anything. Haile cannot go back home and say that he didn't run because they did not water the track."
Hermens said he believed the track should also be watered for the 5,000 metres if it proved to be successful with the longer event.
Heats for the men's 10,000 metres take place on Sunday.
